layer1_delta: All four Sonnet failures re-verified by Opus; 2 code fixes (breadcrumb null guard, focusable scrolling tables) and 2 stale QA/doc wordings corrected. See resolved[].

resolved.triage_note: inc/breadcrumbs.php:91 reads ->display_name on get_queried_object() without a null guard. /author/<unknown>/ returns HTTP 200 (not 404) and logs a PHP Warning on every request. 6 warnings logged during the walk.
resolved.expected: An author archive for a user that does not exist returns 404 (or the breadcrumb guards null) and nothing is logged to debug.log.
resolved.actual: HTTP 200, empty archive, debug.log: PHP Warning: Attempt to read property "display_name" on null in themes/knowx/inc/breadcrumbs.php on line 91.
resolved.resolution: inc/breadcrumbs.php: author branch now requires a WP_User. Re-verified: two loads of /author/nosuchuser/ added 0 breadcrumbs lines to debug.log. The 200 status comes from 21 seeded posts with post_author 0 on this site; core 404s otherwise.

resolved.triage_note: Two figure.wp-block-table elements (from the compatibility-table and/or api-endpoint patterns) scroll horizontally at 390 but are not keyboard focusable. Axe 4.10.2 rule scrollable-region-focusable, 2 nodes. Clean at 1440. J24 requires patterns to pass axe. Reproduced logged out on a temporary page holding all 16 non-home patterns.
resolved.expected: Every pattern passes axe at 390 and 1440.
resolved.url: http://knowx.local/?page_id=<temp page with patterns> (page deleted after test)
resolved.resolution: assets/js/src/theme.js: .wp-block-table gets tabindex=0 only while it overflows (ResizeObserver). Re-verified at 390: axe wcag2a/aa clean (scrollable-region-focusable gone), focus outline 2px, ArrowRight scrolls; at 1440 no tabindex. Screenshot qa-artifacts/smoke-2.0.0/table-focus-390.png.

resolved.triage_note: category.php sets $knowx_per = 5 and passes it to section-grid.php, so each section card on a product page lists 5 articles plus 'View all N articles'. JOURNEYS.md J2, the runbook C step and docs/website/getting-started/07-multi-product-kb.md all say six. Either the code or the three docs are wrong; 'View all N articles' (uses _n) works.
resolved.expected: Product page lists each section with its first six articles and a View all link.
resolved.actual: Section card shows 5 articles then 'View all 15 articles' (Orbit API, Guides, with 15 articles).
resolved.resolution: Code is right: 5 per section since the first 2.0.0 tag and matches the 5-on-home decision. JOURNEYS J2, runbook C and docs/website/getting-started/07-multi-product-kb.md now say five.

resolved.triage_note: Runbook A2 and J19 expect a support block on the fresh docs home. inc/docs.php:865-868 prints it only when a support link+text or support text is configured, which D9 also requires. The seeded home therefore has no support block (Docker fresh install and local). Behaviour is deliberate; the runbook/JOURNEYS wording is stale.
resolved.expected: Home shows hero, product cards, recent articles and the support block (per A2/J19).
resolved.actual: Hero, product cards, Featured Articles and Recently Updated render; no support block until the owner sets support text or a link.
resolved.resolution: Deliberate (D9). JOURNEYS J19 and runbook A now say the support block appears once support text or a link is set.
